summary: Focused UI validation of the two owner-reported bugs on the Bulgarian search results page: (1) Back-navigation must show results instantly with no Korean/skeleton flash. (2) Desktop pagination must prefetch on hover; mobile pagination must prefetch when the pagination row scrolls into view. Tested at 1920x1080 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile) against the preview URL. Results: Korean-flash (Hangul) is FIXED — zero Hangul characters observed on the results page at +30/+100/+250/+500 ms after Back. Applied-filter chip renders correct Latin/Bulgarian text ("Марка: Audi") from the very first sampled frame. Hover-to-prefetch on desktop and scroll-into-view-to-prefetch on mobile BOTH WORK correctly and clicking the pagination button after the prefetch fires no additional request (i.e. the click is served from the prefetched promise). Pagination page buttons, prev/next and the Go-to-page jump input all navigate correctly and update the URL. HOWEVER two regressions remain that violate the owner's explicit no-flash rule: (a) a ~250-400 ms LOADING-SKELETON FLASH on Back (78 skeleton nodes, 0 car cards, at +30 ms +100 ms and +250 ms — cards only appear at +500 ms); (b) the Make/Model dropdowns briefly show the 'Any make/model' PLACEHOLDER label (e.g. 'Всички марки') for ~1 frame at +30 ms before flipping to 'Audi (3244)' at +100 ms. Root cause of both is the same: the URL carries English slugs (?make=audi), so on mount `resolving=true` and (i) `runSearch` short-circuits, meaning `cachedSearch(payload)` never runs during the resolving window, and (ii) `TaxonomySelects` is fed `value={resolving ? EMPTY_TAX : tax}` so it renders empty until slugs resolve.

ui_bugs.issue: Loading-skeleton flash on Back navigation. Observed 78 skeleton nodes and 0 [data-testid=car-card-open] cards at +30 ms, +100 ms and +250 ms after browser Back from /bg/car/<id> to /bg?make=audi. Car cards only re-appear at +500 ms. Owner's requirement explicitly states 'no loading skeleton flash'. Cache hit does not occur because runSearch is short-circuited while `resolving===true` (URL slug 'audi' needs to be translated to '아우디' first). By the time resolving flips to false ~200-400 ms later, the initial `loading=true` state has already painted the skeleton grid.

The Make dropdown briefly shows 'Всички марки' (Any make) placeholder for ~1 frame at +30 ms after Back before flipping to 'Audi (3244)' at +100 ms. Cause: SearchPage passes `value={resolving ? EMPTY_TAX : tax}` — during the ~30-80 ms resolveSlugs round-trip the dropdown is fed EMPTY_TAX so it renders the 'Any' placeholder instead of the actual filter. Not Korean, but still violates the spirit of the 'never a flash of wrong content' rule.

action_items: Eliminate skeleton flash on Back: run the results cache lookup BEFORE the slug-resolution guard, keyed on the URL query string (or on the module-level `results` map). If a cached items array exists for the incoming URL, hydrate `result` and set `loading=false` on the first render — do not wait for resolveSlugs.

Seed the taxonomy dropdown labels synchronously from the already-loaded `getFilters(lang)` cache so the Make/Model selects show their Latin labels on the very first paint after Back, instead of the 'Any' placeholder. Option: keep `value={resolving ? EMPTY_TAX : tax}` for the OPTIONS list only, but derive the currently-selected label from the URL slug -> label map that facets already provide, so the trigger text is correct from paint #1.

Optionally cache the last-seen result set together with its URL (module-level, like `pendingRestore`) so even the first mount right after Back can hydrate synchronously without touching the results Map at all.
critical_code_review_comments: SearchPage.js line 288-292: the debounce (280 ms) is applied to Back navigation too. That alone would delay the eventual cachedSearch hit that ends the skeleton state. Consider skipping the debounce when payload equals the initial payload (Back path) — fire runSearch immediately.

SearchPage.js line 526: `value={resolving ? EMPTY_TAX : tax}` was added defensively to stop slugs feeding into level-2/3/4 lookups; the side effect is that dropdown TRIGGER text is empty during the resolving window. Split the concern: keep EMPTY_TAX for the cascading fetch effects, but pass the URL-derived label straight to the <select> value so the visible label never blanks.

api.js `cachedSearch`: cache key is JSON.stringify(body). The body contains the `taste` object when sort=relevant, and `taste` mutates on every `noteSearch(body)` call. tasteSnapshot IS pinned per {filters,tax,sort,lang} key, so two consecutive visits should match — but this is fragile: any code path that reads getTaste() outside tasteFor (e.g. a future refactor) will silently break the Back cache. Consider stripping `taste` from the cache key and re-attaching it just before the network call.
ResultsPagination.js IntersectionObserver uses `rootMargin: 200px` and disconnects after firing — good, that is why Playwright observed exactly ONE POST on mobile scroll-into-view.

Prefetch dedup in api.js relies on Playwright noticing the POST BEFORE the promise settles. In manual testing the second hover fires nothing because the target page is already in `prefetched` — this is the correct behavior, not a bug (verified by clicking page 2 after hover and seeing zero new POSTs).

success_rate.frontend: 3/5 acceptance criteria fully met, 2 partial (skeleton flash + placeholder-label flash on Back)

test_credentials: Not needed — all flows tested as anonymous visitor on /bg.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only interactions with Audi (3244 cars) and Audi A1 (6 cars) searches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified with Playwright at 1920x1080 and 390x844 against https://encar-multi-lang.preview.emergentagent.com/bg. Reproduction of skeleton flash: open /bg, pick Audi from the make dropdown, wait for pagination to appear, click any car card (use JS click on [data-testid=car-card-open] — the div is 100% width but Playwright sometimes reports it not visible when a parent CTA button overlays it). On the car page, browser-Back; sample document.querySelectorAll('.animate-pulse').length and .car-card-open count at +30/+100/+250 ms after go_back(). Cards only appear at +500 ms in every run I did. Also verified: POST /api/search count during first ~1.8 s after Back = 1 (background refresh) — visitor SHOULD NOT see this, but they do because the initial paint is the skeleton grid. Hover prefetch: fires page=2 POST when synth `mouseenter` is dispatched (or Playwright .hover() with pagination-page-2 scrolled into view for the first time). Note that Playwright's .hover() auto-scrolls the target into view first, which by itself triggers the IntersectionObserver — so if you clear the request counter AFTER the scroll, the second hover shows 0 POSTs and you can wrongly conclude prefetch is broken. Use a synthetic dispatchEvent('mouseenter') to isolate the hover prefetch from the IO prefetch (that is how I confirmed both mechanisms work independently).
rca of the issue: Skeleton + placeholder flash on Back both come from `resolving` staying true for the ~200-400 ms that resolveSlugs(?make=audi) takes to reply. SearchPage.js:288 short-circuits the search effect while resolving, so runSearch never gets to hit `cachedSearch(payload)` during that window; result stays at {items:[],total:0,pages:0} and loading stays at its initial `true`, so CarGrid renders 78 skeleton nodes. SearchPage.js:526 passes EMPTY_TAX to TaxonomySelects while resolving, so the Make dropdown shows 'Всички марки' (Any make) instead of 'Audi (3244)' during the same window. Both are collateral of a defensive guard that was added to stop the cascading getTaxonomy(level=2/3/4) calls from being fired with English slugs. Cleanest fix is to (a) look up the cached results synchronously in a useMemo keyed on `location.pathname+location.search` and hydrate `result` immediately on mount, and (b) render the taxonomy dropdown TRIGGER label from the URL-derived name (which `getFilters` already exposes as `label`+`slug` pairs) so the currently-selected label never flashes even one frame.
